rationale: Houthis tighten Red Sea grip continuing threat to Atlantic shipping and energy costs; Israel-Hezbollah escalation persists; France train derailment is nearby but no direct Portuguese impact.

top_events.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
top_events.label: Houthis seize Perim island Red Sea route
top_events.summary: Iran-backed Houthis capture strategic Perim island on major shipping lane, tightening control over Bab al-Mandab and threatening Atlantic shipping connections and fuel costs.

top_events.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
top_events.label: Israel destroys Hezbollah underground base Lebanon
top_events.summary: Massive blast equivalent to magnitude 4.1 earthquake destroys major Hezbollah base in Lebanon, continuing Middle East escalation with indirect energy market risk.

top_events.title: Passenger train derails in France leaving at least 44 injured
top_events.label: France train derails 44 injured Normandy
top_events.summary: Train operating Rouen-Caen route in Normandy derails with 180 passengers aboard, injuring 44. Western EU incident but no direct impact on Portuguese life.

short_summary: Houthis seize Mokha port near key strait

most_significant_event.label: Houthis seize Mokha port near key strait
most_significant_event.summary: Capture brings Iran-backed group closer to controlling Bab al-Mandab Strait, a vital shipping route for Atlantic-connected energy and goods, raising supply chain risks for Portugal.
most_significant_event.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
